scope: Employee workspace only: Home, Personal, My reviews, My visits/detail, Visit map, Calendar, Time off, Hours & documents, Availability.
goal: Consistent macOS visual hierarchy with readable record state and direct access to employee actions. User additionally requested minimal animation on switches and fewer repeated icons.
assumptions: Employees may use desktop keyboard/mouse or a phone. Actual staff preferences, task frequency and measured usability are unknown.
Keep existing office/client styling and employee business logic intact.
Browser-local sample data and access controls remain as before.

flow.goal: Identify current employee and find a destination
flow.information: Identity, active navigation, primary action and clear labels

flow.goal: Read updates, find visit, record work, manage time off
flow.information: Visit time/client/status, unread state and leave request status
flow.action: Choose tab/filter, open visit or submit form
flow.feedback: Persistent text status, selected segments, 160ms fade/3px shift on switches
flow.recovery: Edit or withdraw where already supported
flow.success: Saved record and visible resulting status

flow.goal: Recover from invalid request or empty list
flow.hesitation: Motion could mask feedback or distract
flow.feedback: Existing validation remains; no wait on animation
flow.recovery: Retry without losing the navigation context
flow.success: Valid request saved; empty result understandable

patterns: Reeder-inspired readable pane hierarchy and shared neutral macOS tokens
Segmented view controls and persistent navigation; text-only Quick links with active-state feedback
Short interruptible transitions for page/tab/filter/pagination switches, disabled by reduced-motion preference

evidence.principle: Pointer target size and visible keyboard focus
evidence.participants_task: Web accessibility standards, not an OCD employee study
evidence.finding: Minimum target sizing or spacing and visible keyboard focus support operation
evidence.boundary: WCAG floor does not establish ideal employee screen density or certify this whole app
evidence.implication: 36px navigation on desktop; 44px mobile controls; visible focus; labels wrap on small screens
evidence.falsifier: Clipped labels, lost focus, or more incorrect activations in a staff trial

evidence.participants_task: Meta-analysis of 63 conditions/50 experiments, N=5036; task/population differs from employee administration
evidence.finding: Near-zero average choice-overload effect with substantial heterogeneity
evidence.boundary: Not evidence for a fixed navigation item limit or guaranteed task gains
evidence.implication: Keep all destinations; reduce decoration and clarify active state instead of hiding choices
evidence.falsifier: Employees take longer to find a destination or confuse labels

evidence.principle: Nonessential interaction motion can cause harm or distraction
evidence.participants_task: WCAG 2.3.3 Level AAA guidance addressing vestibular sensitivity; not a universal animation-duration experiment
evidence.finding: Interaction-triggered movement should be disableable when not essential
evidence.boundary: AAA criterion, not an AA requirement; 160ms/3px is a design choice, not a research-established optimum
evidence.implication: Honor prefers-reduced-motion; cancel previous transitions on rapid switches; never block state updates or controls
evidence.falsifier: Any animation still starts under reduced motion, interaction is delayed, or users report discomfort

evidence.participants_task: Apple platform guidance, not a comparative experiment
evidence.finding: Comfortable density and keyboard support suit desktop productivity
evidence.boundary: Browser interface uses system font fallback on Linux; this is not native AppKit
evidence.implication: Use shared neutral tokens, compact controls and stable grouping
evidence.falsifier: Readability or task completion worsens compared to previous employee UI

validationPlan: Existing employee-portal, React frontend and offline-shell test files
Desktop 1440px and mobile 390px screenshots for nine employee sections
Visit detail, 320px home/personal, leave save/reload/withdraw/invalid-date error, unread/filter/tab behavior and persona switching
Animation interception verifies 160ms switch effect and no calls under reduced motion; keyboard Tab/focus and 200% CSS zoom reflow checks
metricRecommendation: Compare staff time and wrong-destination actions for finding a visit, marking an update read and requesting leave. Gather motion comfort feedback. No measured usability benefit is claimed.
userCorrections: Increase readable scale; macOS should not imply tiny controls
Map side panel overflow reproduced at1736x1000,1440x900,1280x800,1024x768
Quick links must not repeat decorative calendar icons
mapRootCause: Absolutely positioned map sidebar had max-height:none and overflow:visible while its map shrank with the viewport. Applying a temporary bottom bound and overflow:auto made the original geometry checks pass. Final layout uses in-flow split panes.
